outcome: Authorised and failed differently: HTTP 524, a gateway timeout, with a Cloudflare HTML page as the body. Not a model error and not a parameter error — the chain answers inside the HTTP response, and four sequential reasoning calls do not finish inside the gateway's window. Zero answers of one. Not retried: one authorisation is one run.
what_may_still_exist: The n8n execution may have COMPLETED and may hold the answer. The timeout is between this machine and n8n, not inside n8n. Nothing here has read it.
charged: unestablished, and this time probably yes: unlike the HTTP 400 before it, inference had started. The record says may have been charged because that is what is known.
structural_finding: The webhook-response shape cannot carry a slow model. Every measurement so far rode on a model fast enough to answer four times inside one HTTP request. That was an accident of the model, not a property of the design, and it is now the binding constraint.

totals.why: No reply reached this machine. The usage may exist in the n8n execution and has not been read.
